name: parent-premises
document:
schema:
  deps: rests_on
  predicate: wrong_if
  snapshot: seen
known:
  p.x:
    v: 1
  p.y:
    v: 2
judgments:
  d.keep:
    rests_on:
    - p.x
    verdict: change
    wrong_if: p.x > 4
    seen:
      p.x: 1

expected.notice:
nearest existing:
  d.keep: rests on p.x too - verdicts differ, a pair to judge
  one subject: same <id> d.other folds it in · two: distinct d.other <id> "why" keeps them apart

reasons: rests on p.x too - verdicts differ, a pair to judge
